title: Widget configuration
description: Declares how the page builder treats a widget. The file lives next to the widget implementation and is read at build time, so its values are known before the widget itself is loaded.

$schema.description: Path or url of this schema. Enables autocompletion and validation in the editor.

layout.description: How the container that the page builder renders around the widget behaves.

applyMediaMargins.description: On which sides the widget gets the media widget margins that merchants configure in the theme settings. Margins configured for a single widget instance in the page builder always win. Widgets that bring their own spacing should leave this out.

oneOf.description: true applies the media widget margins to all four sides, false to none.
Opts in per side. An omitted side does not get the margin.

top.description: Whether the widget gets the media widget margin above it.

bottom.description: Whether the widget gets the media widget margin below it.

left.description: Whether the widget gets the media widget margin on its left. Widgets that are meant to touch the screen edges leave this out.

right.description: Whether the widget gets the media widget margin on its right. Widgets that are meant to touch the screen edges leave this out.
